theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (f : Euclid P → ℝ) (f' : Euclid P →L[ℝ] ℝ) (x v : Euclid P), HasFDerivWithinAt f f' M x → v ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x) → fderivWithin ℝ f M x v = f' v
